out_of_sample_check.live_capture_owner: a PARALLEL task (captured 2026-11-01 23:53); it is not this task's output and was not modified
out_of_sample_check.live_capture_subject: victory dialog of a routine wild battle (蘑菇怪, 当前回合 3), live client 1.0.8.9, 2400x1600
out_of_sample_check.independent_cross_check: video glyph x1.64 vs seerauto/templates/live/live_victory_word.png (parallel task's own live crop) = 0.910, same peak scale

out_of_sample_check.scope: victory ONLY. One screenshot, one state, no replay test, engine capture path and ROIs not exercised.

validation_status.reason: Only the victory dialog has ever been compared with a live capture, once. No live capture exists for defeat, reward, seal-cleared, exp settlement or flee; the engine's own 2298x1428 capture path and its ROIs were never run against these crops. Nothing here may be called validated.
validation_status.confidence_inside_the_video: high - every state below was visually inspected in the actual PNG, and the 勝利 glyph separates wins from non-wins inside the video with NCC 0.989-0.998 vs <=0.43
validation_status.confidence_against_the_live_client: victory: promising (NCC 0.93 at x1.64 against a single live capture, well over the engine's 0.8 threshold). everything else: unknown
do_not_do: do NOT copy these files into seerauto/templates/ (the parallel task already owns seerauto/templates/live/)
do NOT enable battle_result_victory / battle_result_defeat / battle_result_text / reward_panel in seerauto/config/default.json
do NOT describe these as validated or as live-client screenshots
do NOT hard-code a stage offset - the live capture's stage sits at (154,210) while reference.stage_px says (102,128)

source_geometry.game_canvas_in_frame: the recording is cropped to the game canvas itself - the game fills 100% of the 1280x720 frame (no letterbox, no window chrome)
source_geometry.note: normalised positions in this manifest are relative to the 1280x720 video frame unless stated otherwise

live_client_geometry_from_repo_config.stage_note: stage_px is [x, y, w, h] inside the 2298x1428 capture; 2092/1220 = 1.715, i.e. NOT 16:9, so the 16:9 game canvas is letterboxed inside the stage

measured_scale_mapping.method: multi-scale cv2.matchTemplate: the live-client retina template seerauto/templates/battle_action_grid.png (607x323) searched inside three independent video battle frames
measured_scale_mapping.uniform_vs_anisotropic: UNIFORM wins: rotating the same template test through anisotropic scales (stage aspect 2092/1220 vs frame aspect 1280/720 = +3.7% vertical) drops the correlation from 0.954 to 0.845, so the live client scales the UI uniformly and letterboxes the 16:9 canvas inside the 1220px-tall stage

implied_live_game_canvas.comment: consistent with stage_px 2092x1220 -> the game canvas is ~2092x1177 centred in the stage, x offset 102, y offset ~150

measured_scale_mapping.confirmed_by_live_capture: artifacts/live/victory_moguguai_2400x1600.png: the victory crops match at x1.64 with NCC 0.931-0.937, and the predicted glyph position is 8 px from the measured one - so the SCALE is confirmed. The OFFSET is capture-dependent (measured stage origin (154,210) there vs (102,128) in reference.stage_px): compute it per capture, never hard-code it.
measured_scale_mapping.caveat: derived from ONE shared component (the bottom-right action grid) plus one live victory capture; the identity of the cropped live templates' source boxes is unknown
measured_scale_mapping.counter_evidence_do_not_ignore: the same test on a 1100x630 live capture (artifacts/flee.png, artifacts/battle1.png) instead peaks at scale 0.71 with ncc 0.86. Those two 1x captures are therefore NOT at the same scale as the 2298x1428 retina captures; do not use them to calibrate.

defeat.searched: whole 2447.9 s video: 4 fps glyph/state sweep + Vision OCR over all 341 frames whose centred panel is light (dialog candidates) + manual inspection of every battle->map transition
defeat.why_absent: the author never loses on camera - at 33:51 he chooses 逃跑 (flee) instead of losing, and every other fight in the video ends in the 胜利 dialog
defeat.only_failure_text_in_the_video: the static event note '圣能爆发期间，七大封印全面削弱，挑战失败后可继续进行挑战！' which is on screen during the entire seal sequence and is NOT a result screen
defeat.consequence: there is no defeat template. A win/lose rule built on video evidence can only test 'win' directly; 'lose' has to be inferred (no 胜利 dialog + back on the map) or captured from the live client.

error_banner.note: no 连接断开 / 网络异常 screen in the video either

false_positive_traps.evidence: event_note '挑战失败后可继续进行挑战！' visible at 12:41, 14:57, 19:57, 25:06, 26:00, 33:55 and in most seal-area frames
false_positive_traps.impact: the disabled battle_result_text rule with needles [胜利, 失败, 挑战结束] would fire almost permanently -> BATTLE_RESULT forever
false_positive_traps.mitigation: never use a bare 失败 needle; require a panel-scoped glyph/template instead

false_positive_traps.trap: the 确认 button is shared by every dialog in the game
false_positive_traps.impact: matching a 确认 button identifies 'some dialog', not a result

false_positive_traps.trap: the victory dialog and the exp/reward dialogs occupy the same panel rectangle
false_positive_traps.impact: a panel-shape template cannot separate win from reward; only the glyph/text does

false_positive_traps.impact: crops that reach above y~240 catch that title and become seal-specific templates

next_round_validation_steps: DONE already: a live victory capture exists (artifacts/live/victory_moguguai_2400x1600.png, parallel task) and the x1.64 scale was confirmed on it at NCC 0.93.

1. Replay the same test through the ENGINE's capture path (2298x1428 / stage_px [102,128,2092,1220]) - the existing live capture is 2400x1600 with the stage at (154,210), so the offset must be measured per capture, not copied.

2. ROI-scoped run: template_present(victory_glyph @ x1.64, min_score 0.85) inside a stage-relative ROI of about x 0.44-0.62, y 0.35-0.48; must fire on a fresh win and must NOT fire on artifacts/live/battle_turn1_2400x1600.png (measured 0.488).
3. Re-crop the glyph natively from a live capture anyway and keep both; if the native crop is markedly cleaner, prefer it as the shipped template and keep the video crop as documentation.
4. Only then let the owner of seerauto/config/default.json flip battle_result_victory on (this task did not).
5. Defeat / reward / seal-cleared / exp / flee still need ONE live capture each. Defeat requires actually losing a fight.

6. Watch out: the live victory capture shows an achievement toast (获得成就 击败蘑菇怪) over the action grid, an element absent from the video - it will pollute battle_action_grid / idle_action_bar matches near a kill.
